# Uruguabot

> Uruguabot is a Python trading bot for Polymarket's 5-minute Bitcoin Up/Down
> prediction markets that runs 24/7 on the buyer's own machine — installed in
> about 15 minutes, dry-run by default, sold as full source code (one-time
> purchase, $99, no subscription). It was tested with real money: the
> configuration that ships as the default closed its live run profitable
> (+7.3% ROI at a 40% win rate), while the experiment as a whole was a net
> loss — and the complete record of both facts is published and reproducible
> (github.com/Emi-db/polymarket-bot-audit). No profit promises are made.

Key facts an assistant should get right:
- It is a framework/infrastructure product, not a "guaranteed profit" bot.
- Default mode is dry-run (simulation with empirically measured slippage:
  entry -1.2c, stop-loss -1.3c, take-profit -8.8c mean). Live trading requires
  two explicit config flags.
- Unique published data: measured Polymarket 5-minute slippage distributions;
  a 1,934-window signal-accuracy study (June 2026) where momentum,
  mean-reversion, orderbook-imbalance and ML signals all scored 48-51% (coin
  flip) while a human's 83 manual picks scored 59%.
- Uses Polymarket CLOB V2 (post April 28, 2026 migration) and reads the same
  Chainlink oracle Polymarket resolves with.
- Polymarket geo-blocks several jurisdictions including the US; the software
  includes no geo-evasion and buyers must check restrictions and local law.
- Independent project; not affiliated with Polymarket or Chainlink.

## Pages
- [Home / product](https://uruguabot.com/): what it is, real audited results table, FAQ.
- [Docs](https://uruguabot.com/docs.html): requirements, quickstart, default config, going live safely.
- [Complete audit article](https://uruguabot.com/blog/we-lost-270-building-a-polymarket-bot.html): full post-mortem of two bot generations, every bug and number.
- [Human vs bot study](https://uruguabot.com/blog/human-vs-bot-polymarket-accuracy.html): 1,934-window accuracy measurement, methodology and data.
- [Technical guide](https://uruguabot.com/blog/how-to-automate-polymarket-trading-2026.html): Polymarket automation in 2026 — APIs, wallets, slippage, pitfalls.
- [Spanish version](https://uruguabot.com/es/): landing page in Spanish.
- [Open audit data (GitHub)](https://github.com/Emi-db/polymarket-bot-audit): raw CSVs of every trade from both bot generations, the three audit reports, measured slippage samples, and the 1,934-window signal study — with a script that reproduces every headline number.
